跟着节奏，一步一步跑。: Find your rhythm. One step at a time.
一声一步 · 左右交替: One click, one step · Left, right
每秒 3 步 · 每 0.333 秒一声: 3 steps / second · one click every 0.333 s
开始后尝试保持亮屏: Will try to keep the screen on when you start
使用时请保持此页面打开。锁屏或切换应用可能使节拍暂停。: Keep this page open while running. Locking your screen or switching apps may pause the clicks.
每一声对应一步，左右脚交替。: Take one step with each click, alternating feet.
180 是起始设置，可按自己的节奏调整。: Start at 180 and adjust to your own rhythm.
节拍数为播放计数，不是实际步数。: Clicks played are not measured footsteps.
请启用 JavaScript 后使用节拍器。: Please enable JavaScript to use the metronome.
找到节奏，专注脚下。: Find your rhythm. Focus on the next step.
开始播放后再锁屏；用 iPhone 音量键调节声音。: Start playback, then lock your iPhone. Use its volume buttons.
锁屏模式请用手机音量键调节声音。: Use your phone’s volume buttons in lock-screen mode.
开始播放后，可以关闭屏幕: Start playback, then turn off the screen
保留其他音乐，需保持页面亮屏: Keep other music playing; keep this page on screen
锁屏模式可能暂停其他音乐 App。请在 Safari 中打开，先播放再锁屏；锁屏: Lock-screen mode may pause other music apps. Open in Safari, start playback, then lock your screen. Use the lock-screen play/pause controls.
配合音乐时，锁屏或切换应用可能使节拍暂停。: When playing alongside music, locking the screen or switching apps may pause the clicks.
